questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer a, b, c, d
Set a = 15, b = 4, c = 3
Set d = a / b * c + a mod b
Print d
questions.explanation: In integer arithmetic, a / b is 15 / 4 = 3. Then (3 * 3) = 9. a mod b is 15 mod 4 = 3. So d = 9 + 3 = 12.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer p, q, r
Set p = 20, q = 6, r = 2
Set p = p / q + p mod (r + 1)
Print p
questions.explanation: r + 1 = 3. Integer division p / q = 20 / 6 = 3. 20 mod 3 = 2. So p = 3 + 2 = 5.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following pseudocode?
questions.code:
Integer x, y, z
Set x = 8, y = 3
Set z = (x * y) / (x - y) + (x mod y)
Print z
questions.explanation: (x * y) = 24. (x - y) = 5. Integer division 24 / 5 = 4. 8 mod 3 = 2. So z = 4 + 2 = 6.

questions.explanation: a / b = 25 / 7 = 3. Then b * 3 = 21. Finally c = 25 - 21 = 4. (Notice this is equivalent to a mod b).
